title: A Smith's First Tool
description:
Now we're talking. You got your template, so it's time to make your first pickaxe. It's crucial you know that templates for things like tools [will only craft the head of an item](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/pickaxe_0.png:168:140). This on its own is fine, just means [you'll hav' ta then put the head of the tool in a crafting grid with a [rod/handle](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/pickaxe_1.png:168:140). If you'd like to not do this, however, [you can also put the rod in the crafting grid with the template and materials](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/pickaxe_2.png:168:140). Simple but skips a step, y'know? Efficient.
Now then, go ahead and craft a pickaxe. And I mean craft one, not just get one from a friend.
